εὐρυχόρῳ: εὐρύχορος — with broad spaces, spacious; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg.
κέρδεα: κέρδος — gain, profit; neut. acc. pl. κέρδεα, extended sense ’cunning, craft’
κυβερνήτης: κυβερνήτης — helmsman, steersman; masc. nom. sg.
λήθει: λήθω (= Attic λανθάνω) — escape the notice of (+ acc.); pres. 3 sg., with a participle: ’escapes notice’
λήσει: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); fut. 3 sg.: ’will escape’
λεῖος: λεῖος — smooth; adj., masc. nom. sg., + gen. of separation: ’free of, smooth of’
μήτι: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft; fem. dat. sg., dative of respect ’in cunning’ (cf. acc. μῆτιν)
ναῖεν: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, have one’s home; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’dwelt’
νοέοντι: νοέω — perceive, understand; pres. part. act., masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νοοῦντι): ’to one who understands’
οἴνοπι: οἶνοψ — wine-dark, wine-faced (of the sea); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
πέμπτος: πέμπτος — fifth; masc. nom. sg.: ’as fifth’
παρέλθῃ: παρέρχομαι — pass by, outstrip; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a fear clause after μή
τέρματ: τέρμα — boundary-mark, goal, end-post; neut. acc. pl., elided (τέρματ’ = τέρματα)
ἀληθείην: ἀλήθεια — truth; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic ἀληθείη)
ἀριστερὸς: ἀριστερός — left, on the left; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’on the left’
ἀριφραδές: ἀριφραδής — very clear, plain; neut. acc. sg., with σῆμα
ἐλαύνων: ἐλαύνω — drive, urge on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’driving, riding’
ἐλεγχείη: ἐλεγχείη — reproach, disgrace; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic ἐλεγχεία)
ἔτραφεν: τρέφω — nourish; pass. grow up; intrans. aor. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἐτράφησαν): ’they were reared’
ἕλῃσι: αἱρέω — take, catch; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἕλῃ)
ἦκ: ἦκα — gently, softly, lightly; adv., elided (ἦκ’ = ἦκα)
